intended_object: A helper constructor. It packages a rational map r : X ⤏ Y together with proofs that r pulls dense opens back to dense opens and lies over S into a term of the structure `Hom X Y`. This is clear from the docstring and the body `⟨r, hr, hS⟩`.
explanation: The body is just the anonymous constructor `⟨r, hr, hS⟩` of the structure `DenseOpenRationalSchemeOver.Hom`, used to make building terms more convenient. The mathematical content, namely the arrows of the category of dense-open rational maps over S, lives in the structure `Hom`. This wrapper adds nothing to it, so it has no mathematical counterpart of its own. It is an implementation convenience.
